question: How does the one reality become a fifteen-fold structure when differentiated by its own principles?
premises: From the preceding account, the one reality is described as fifteen-fold.
That one reality is grouped in fives together with prakṛti.
When differentiated one by one, each division takes the form of its own principle.
inference: Therefore the single reality unfolds into a fifteen-fold structure through fivefold grouping and further differentiation into its own tattvas.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the fivefold grouping with prakṛti is not fully specified in this verse alone.
plain_english: From that, the one reality is described as fifteen-fold, grouped in fives together with prakṛti. Even there, when divided one by one, each division takes on the nature of its own principle.
